newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Friday September 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Friday September 6.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in Italy's leading headlines.
* President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro says Italy will remain united despite attempts by seperatist party the Northern League's to divide her. (All)

* Italy's highest court on Thursday called for a constitutional ruling on whether former German SS officer Erich Priebke was legitimately re-arrested after he was controversially freed by a war crimes trial in July. (All)
* Troubled hi-tech company Olivetti suspended trading Thursday. It says it will be set to issue a statement on Friday morning after meetings with stock market watchdog Consob. (All)
* National Statistics Institute reports that Italian inflation fell to 3.4 percent in August, the lowest since the summer of 1969. But petrol prices rise. (La Stampa, Il Sole)
* Managing director of energy giant ENI Franco Bernabe says that he no longer needs half his work force. (Corriere)
* In light of new legislation regulating conflicts of interests, pension funds are divided between banks and insurance companies. (Il Sole)
* Steel production falls 13 percent in the first seven months of 1996. (Il Sole)
Reuters has not verified these stories and can not vouch for their accuracy.
